answer: Physical Substrate Attestation. Each agent node must periodically prove possession of a distinct physically unclonable surface: a challenge-response measured from an onyx-grade microtexture die, signed and timestamped. A hollow cluster of virtual identities all resolving to one operator’s hardware collapses because the challenge set exceeds the die’s addressable cells, forcing collisions that flag duplicates. Enforcement runs each epoch, with a spiral queue of fresh challenges. An attacker’s cost is one fabricated die per identity, plus continuous re-measurement, not just a copied key.
